title: Supercapatteries: unlocking the potential of battery-supercapacitor fusion
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04348K, Review Article
Selvaraj Seenivasan, Sangeeta Adhikari, Amarnath T. Sivagurunathan, Do-Heyoung Kim
Supercapatteries represent the ultimate coexistence of high power and high energy density in a single energy storage device. This review highlights the importance of quantitative criteria that differentiate supercapatteries from hybrid capacitors.
